title: Length of the deepest path equals the depth
statement: Let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ Boolean variables. Then the deepest root-to-leaf path of $T$ has length equal to the depth of $T$; that is, the number of branch queries along that path is exactly $\mathrm{depth}(T)$.
hypotheses_covered: T is a decision tree on n Boolean variables
replaced:
For every decision tree $T$, the length of its deepest path equals its depth:
$T.\mathrm{deepPath}.\mathrm{length} = T.\mathrm{depth}$.
